purpose: Teach: 輪廻/撃沈/怒涛/凱旋/建立/警備隊/生まれつき/オウム真理教

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期患者の輪廻信仰を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: We make sure to honor our end-of-life patients' beliefs about reincarnation across the whole medical team.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Slight pause before 'honor' — the weight of the commitment. Professional but not cold. Steady eye contact through the statement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染源を撃沈する勢いで撲滅対策を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes. We tackle infection control with the same intensity as eliminating the source itself — it's how our team operates.
lines.style: Clear, deliberate pacing. A subtle firmness on 'tackle' and 'eliminating.' Not unkind, but this is how it's done. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症の怒涛のような流行を、貴院、対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital responded to that fierce wave of infections, didn't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet admiration underneath. Tentative, like he's testing whether he understands correctly. Slight upward lift at the end, seeking confirmation. Respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、難病克服の凱旋例を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes. We look to the cases where we've overcome difficult diseases — those successes guide how we approach problems as a team.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. A hint of quiet pride on 'overcome' and 'successes,' but understated. Not boastful. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療研究所を建立される予定なんですね、先生
lines.en: I see you're planning to establish a medical research institute, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, careful phrasing. Not quite a question, more like thinking aloud with respect. Soft and observant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療警備隊との連携訓練を医療チームで実施します
lines.en: Yes. We conduct joint training exercises with the medical security unit — that coordination is essential to how we function.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Professional certainty. A slight emphasis on 'essential' — this is core to the operation. No flourish, just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生まれつきの障害を持つ患者さんへのケアを、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has really strengthened the care you provide to patients born with congenital disabilities, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant and sincere. Quiet respect in how he phrases it. Slower pace, allowing weight to each phrase. Not flattering — genuine acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、オウム真理教事件後の精神医療を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes. We draw on what we learned from mental health care in the years after the Aum incident — those lessons inform how our team treats vulnerable patients.
lines.style: Grave, measured, respectful of historical weight. A small pause before 'Aum' — acknowledgment of its significance. Professional but not detached. This is serious learning.
